title: Minute Out In It: Mollie’s Pack Carrying Toys to Den
licence: Public domain — work of the U.S. National Park Service (federal government). NPS media pages: items without a © symbol or non-NPS credit are public domain. Credit line recorded below.
contents: Remote trail-camera clips (day colour + night IR) of Mollie's Pack wolves trotting toward the den carrying "toys" (bones, antlers, an elk leg, a clump of grass) for their pups. Soft music track; small burned-in caption "[upbeat music synchronized with wolf steps]" at ~6–8 s.
